Dear Actief Interim Oostkamp team,

I am writing to apply for the Warehouse Worker position (2-shift system) at your client in Oostkamp. I have recent warehouse experience at Katoen Natie in Antwerp, where I maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume logistics environment. I am comfortable with physical work, including loading and unloading, and I am eager to work in a cold environment. I have my own transportation and am legally permitted to work in Belgium.

I am available to start immediately and am interested in a long-term opportunity. I am a quick learner and would welcome the chance to receive reach truck training and grow within the company.

Please find my CV attached. I would be happy to discuss my application further. Thank you for your consideration.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Actief Interim Oostkamp team,

I am excited to apply for the Warehouse Worker position (2-shift system) at your client in Oostkamp. With recent warehouse experience at Katoen Natie in Antwerp, I am well-prepared for the physical and logistical demands of this role. I am comfortable working in cold environments and have experience with electric pallet trucks (EPT), which I used to move goods efficiently and safely.

In my previous warehouse role, I maintained accuracy and efficiency in a fast-paced, high-volume setting. I am used to loading and unloading trucks, performing quality checks, and keeping the workspace organized and safe. I am also a quick learner and would welcome the opportunity to receive internal reach truck training and expand my skills.

I am already living in Belgium, have my own transportation, and am legally permitted to work. I am available to start immediately and am looking for a stable, long-term position. The English-speaking environment is a great fit for me, as I work professionally in English and am currently improving my Dutch.

I am drawn to this role because of the job security, training opportunities, and the supportive measures for cold environments, such as thermal clothing and paid breaks. I am confident that my work ethic and adaptability will make me a valuable addition to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your client's operations.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
